title: Disable HD Audio power saving to fix pops
summary: Disabling power saving for the snd_hda_intel module can fix popping or clicking sounds when audio starts or stops.

steps.explain: Create or edit the file /etc/modprobe.d/alsa-base.conf and add the line: options snd_hda_intel power_save=0 power_save_controller=N
Reboot the system to apply the kernel module parameter.

rollback.explain: Remove the line added to /etc/modprobe.d/alsa-base.conf or delete the file if it was created just for this.

warnings: Disabling power saving may slightly increase power consumption.
